nodes.description: Ownable._owner: address of the current contract owner.
Managerable._managerAddress: address of the privileged manager.
ImportFNXMinePool._FnxMinePool: interface handle to the FNX mine pool.
timeLimitation.itemTimeMap: item key to last transfer-in timestamp.
timeLimitation.limitation: burn waiting period (1 hour default).
FPTData._totalLockedWorth: total locked worth in USD.
FPTData.lockedTotalWorth: user locked worth in USD.
baseProxy.implementation: address of the delegatecall implementation.
Ownable constructor: sets deployer as owner.
setTimeLimitation(uint256): owner-only change of burn limitation.
setItemTimeLimitation(uint256): records block timestamp for an item.
baseProxy constructor: stores implementation and delegatecalls initialize().
setImplementation(address): owner-only implementation swap plus delegatecall update().
delegateToImplementation(bytes): public unrestricted delegatecall of raw data.
Erc20BaseProxy constructor: forwards implementation to baseProxy.
FPTProxy constructor: wires implementation, mine pool, name and symbol.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership and manager checks.
now / block.timestamp: miner-influenced time used for burn limitation.
delegatecall to implementation with initialize() selector in baseProxy constructor.
delegatecall to implementation with update() selector in setImplementation.
unrestricted public delegatecall of caller-supplied data into implementation.
staticcall to self performing a delegate-to-view hop.
staticcall with msg.data plus inline assembly returndatacopy/revert/return.
delegatecall with msg.data plus inline assembly returndatacopy/revert/return.
success flag returned by the delegatecall in delegateToImplementation.
raw returndata of the delegatecall in delegateToImplementation.
success flag returned by the staticcall in delegateToViewImplementation.
raw returndata of the staticcall in delegateToViewImplementation.
Unchecked addition itemTimeMap[item]+limitation inside OutLimitation require.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns _owner = msg.sender (deployer becomes owner).
isOwner compares msg.sender against the stored _owner.
owner() returns _owner.
renounceOwnership writes _owner = address(0).
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
transferOwnership forwards execution to _transferOwnership.

onlyOwner modifier requires isOwner() to succeed.

getFNXMinePoolAddress reads _FnxMinePool.
fnxMinePool parameter is cast and stored into _FnxMinePool.

setTimeLimitation writes the limitation state variable.
_limitation parameter is stored into limitation.
item parameter indexes itemTimeMap during the write.

block timestamp (now) is stored as the item transfer-in time.
getTimeLimitation reads limitation.
item parameter indexes itemTimeMap during the read.
getItemTimeLimitation reads itemTimeMap[item].
OutLimitation reads itemTimeMap[item] for the time gate.
OutLimitation reads limitation for the time gate.
OutLimitation compares the item time against now (timestamp dependency).
itemTimeMap[item] feeds the unchecked addition in OutLimitation.
limitation feeds the unchecked addition in OutLimitation.
Overflow-prone sum is used in the OutLimitation require.
itemTimeMap[item] feeds the unchecked addition in getItemTimeLimitation.
limitation feeds the unchecked addition in getItemTimeLimitation.
Overflow-prone sum is returned by getItemTimeLimitation.
